sys_hub_flow.description:
Sanitizes the user prompt.

Inputs:

  • Transaction ID - The transaction ID.
  • Definition ID - The definition ID.
  • User Prompt Data - The user prompt data object containing the prompt to be sanitized.
  • Threshold - The threshold value.
  • Multi Language Detection Metadata - The metadata object for enabling multi language detection.
  • Enable Retry Policy - Set to true to enable retry policy.

Outputs:

  • Filter Match State - The overall filter match state for Sanitization.
  • Filter Results - An object containing results for all filters where the key is the filter name.
  • Invocation Result - A field indicating the outcome of the invocation.
  • Sanitization Metadata - An object containing metadata related to Sanitization.
  • Action Status - An object with the following fields:
    • Code - Returns 0 if success and error code if failure occurs.
    • Message - 'Success' if the whole request succeeds or respective error message if a failure occurs.
